facts.text: Eagle Descent Stage was deployed at Sea of Tranquility during Apollo 11 in 1969.

Lower half of the Lunar Module Eagle. Served as the launch platform for the ascent stage. Bears a stainless-steel plaque: "Here men from the planet Earth first set foot upon the Moon July 1969, A.D. We came in peace for all mankind."
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Proved that a piloted spacecraft could safely land on and launch from the lunar surface, validating the Lunar Orbit Rendezvous mission architecture.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Sea of Tranquility.
Remains at Tranquility Base; its plaque reading 'We came in peace for all mankind' is humanity's first permanent marker on another world.
